contract: ROUND-2 FIXTURE/GOLD PREREGISTRATION ONLY; stop before live semantic calls or Stage A
generator_algorithm: 32-bit LCG: state=(1664525*state+1013904223)&0xffffffff; explicit seed; fixed partitioned target blocks; exact byte padding
gold_policy: Grading-only. No helper or company prompt/selected range construction receives gold content/path; no gold-driven expansion or repair after selection.

codex_config.drift_policy: STOP on version/schema/turn-shape drift; missing usage is unknown, never zero; no comparable claim

company_config.thinking_proof: Inspect narrow actual request field chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false, unchanged transport, no Authorization; stop DOGFOOD before measured Codex if not proven
company_config.attempt_policy: One initial attempt; at most one same-config manual retry only for transient transport; retain every attempt and unknown usage. No retry on length or raised max_tokens. No fallback.

company_phase.input_construction: Existing skill + fixed company_instructions below + entire frozen fixture bytes, in source order. No gold, output answer/example or grading labels. Final Codex schema is not passed to company triage. No live call in preregistration.

company_instructions.L01: For the future company test-triage phase use the existing skill's own schema instead of this final schema: preserve exact tests/files, put the observed signature and observation in group evidence, and retain unknowns. This is an adaptation instruction, not a change to the production skill.
company_instructions.L02: For the future company log-triage phase use the existing skill's own schema: evidence must quote each entire canonical EVENT line exactly once, timeline must quote those entire lines in observed order, and error_signatures must list the canonical observed signature names without added prose. Explain repeated patterns and causal unknowns in the remaining skill fields. This fixed format permits mechanical count/order verification without interpreting prose numbers.
company_instructions.L03:
Build a concise evidence-first ContextPacket for the upload-window topic from the supplied mixed evidence only. Inventory rows are background: summarize their irrelevance instead of listing every inventory observation. Keep observed facts, supported inference, unsupported hypothesis, unknowns and verify-next distinct. Return exactly the six-category schema with bounded concise items, no prose/fences, hidden reasoning, tools, file reads, commands or external verification. Do not self-grade.
Every evidence citation must mention exactly one verbatim record_id=<ID> in statement and use that record's exact source and locator values. Cite the records supporting substantive statements, uncertainty and verify-next; do not promote labels from hypothesis or inference to fact. Citation membership checks do not prove semantic completeness. Do not infer a causal effect of a release from temporal proximity.
The future company phase uses the existing context-pack/A4 parser and the same citation convention and topic scope. No category or field is added to the production packet schema.

selector_rules.anchors: Exact canonical identifiers returned by company and independently validated; no file/source-only semantic expansion
selector_rules.cap_excess: Raise SELECTIVE_READ_CAP_INSUFFICIENT; never silently truncate, replace anchors or widen cap
selector_rules.manifest_digest: SHA256 sorted compact UTF-8 JSON excluding manifest_sha256 self-field
selector_rules.raw_digest: SHA256 concatenated source-ordered original byte slices; end byte exclusive

coverage_rules.L01: Anchored canonical FAILURE universe; exact company tests and matching file sets; missing/duplicate/unexpected IDs; failure_id_coverage_complete is syntactic, not root-cause correctness.

L02.canonical: Anchored EVENT lines; exact event/request/signature/timestamp tuples
L02.company_adapter: Existing log-triage evidence and timeline string arrays quote entire EVENT lines verbatim; count parsed entries, compare signature sets and source/timestamp order; prose counts never treated as exact counts.

coverage_rules.L03: Existing A4 ContextPacket parser; evidence statement has exactly one record_id token; source/locator match that record; no unknown/duplicate citation; post-selection membership verifies cited line present. No semantic completeness claim.

selection_sequence: select exact anchors with frozen rules
inject company + coverage + metadata + verbatim selected raw bytes + same task/schema into initial DOGFOOD prompt
measured Codex session only after separate authorization
gold grading after measured execution; never repair omitted selection

dogfood_delivery.unplanned_tool_read: DELIVERY_CONTRACT_VIOLATION; retain actual usage; pair invalid for selective-injection claim

control_delivery: Full bounded fixture plus same task/schema. No company result or other variant output; no tools/raw-read requests.
secondary_KPI: (input_tokens - cached_input_tokens) + output_tokens; descriptive only, never substitutes primary

cache_policy.first_measured_session: Prior measured ID/fixture/variant and elapsed are null; record latest preflight as background separately. Fresh ephemeral does not promise cold cache.

pair_allowance_formula: 3 * selected-size preflight comparable total, fixed before execution
budget_start_rule: Before each pair, remaining=400000 minus actual usage of completed pairs; require remaining >= fixed next pair allowance. Update only after entire pair. Never stop based on favorable/unfavorable result. Insufficient next allowance: BUDGET_CEILING_NOT_STARTED; unknown usage blocks accounting and next start, not zero.

stage_b.trigger: quality parity PASS/EQUIVALENT AND accounting valid AND selective-read contract valid AND Stage-A primary savings >=10%
stage_b.execution: One reversed-order confirmation per qualifying fixture, unchanged immutable artifacts/config, subject to separate authorization and 200k budget
stage_b.interpretation: Selected positive candidates; winner’s curse; not pooled with Stage A as unbiased aggregate/production threshold

failure_flag_policy: Preserve independently; omissions are COMPANY_TRIAGE_COVERAGE_MISS, not cap failure. Cap insufficiency requires adequate company IDs plus failed frozen selection/target inclusion. Semantic quality not inferred from coverage.

blind_grading.assignment: Future labels randomized privately before review; mapping outside grading package and hidden from graders. No fixed variant-to-letter mapping registered.
blind_grading.method: Parsed structured exact IDs/counts/group/citation checks first; blind semantic unknown/evidence/forbidden-claim judgement afterward; executing sessions never self-grade.
blind_grading.disagreement: Quality unresolved; exclude pair from quality-approved aggregates until separately documented independent tie-break; preserve deterministic misses.

freeze_declaration: Source/artifact digests in this file will be committed together before any measured session. No post-result gold, fixture, schema or helper tuning; amendments require recorded authorization and a new preregistration.
stage_a_may_proceed: PENDING independent preregistration review and explicit execution authorization; this turn stops after publication
limitations: Canonical records make syntactic triage easier than messy real logs; no general routing/savings claim.
Real semantic token density and output length may exceed filler forecast; pair allowances are deterministic start rules, not guaranteed runtime upper bounds.
No current company schema/output fit or semantic quality claim; bounded target count only, max_tokens stays 4096.
